name: Read other apps' notifications
plain: Reads what other apps show in the notification shade.
meaning: Notification text can contain codes, messages and private data. Android needs a special setting; iOS exposes this only to paired accessories, with EU forwarding added in 26.3.

android.prompt_ui: Settings > Notifications > Device and app notifications
android.store_policy: Play: user data policy; restricted setting for sideloaded apps
android.note: Android 13 restricted settings applies to sideloaded listener apps.

ios.permission: ANCS for accessories; third party smartwatch notification forwarding (EU)
ios.store_policy: EU only; limited to approved third party accessories
ios.api_surface: ANCS (BLE accessories), EU notification forwarding in iOS 26.3
ios.note: Apps on the same phone cannot read other apps' notifications.

limits.headline: Can see other apps' notifications only on Android after you allow it in Settings
limits.user_action: You open Settings, then Notifications, and switch the app on under Device and app notifications
can: See the text of notifications from other apps, like codes and messages
Pick up what appears in the notification shade
cannot: Turn itself on; you must switch it on
Be enabled in a sideloaded app on Android 13 and later until you allow restricted settings
See other apps' notifications on iPhone
Forward notifications on iPhone except to paired accessories, or EU watches with iOS 26.3
limits.differs: Android lets an enabled listener see notifications; iPhone offers only paired accessories and EU forwarding.

story.what_it_is: Lets an app read what other apps show in your notification shade.
story.for_you: A special setting asks to give an app notification access. If you agree, it can read every notification, including bank codes and private chats. A smartwatch uses it to mirror alerts on your wrist.
story.for_makers: Smartwatch makers, car displays and automation apps need to see alerts. Notification text can hold codes and messages, so a bad app can steal them. That is why Android hides this behind a special switch.

use_cases.example: A smartwatch app mirrors your phone alerts to your wrist.
A car display app reads your messages aloud while you drive.
An automation app turns a delivery alert into a reminder.
A bank code stealing app reads a one time code from a text alert.
A hearing assist app flashes a light when an alert arrives.
A time tracking app counts the notifications from each app.
A home hub says your door bell alert out loud.

story.android_note: Android 13 restricted settings also block sideloaded notification listener apps.
story.ios_note: iPhone does not allow apps to read other apps' notifications.

technical_bounds: iOS limits to accessories and EU

history.change: EU third party accessory notification forwarding
